text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ahead of her challenge in the Twinkle 
Series, true, full-scale training days 
alongside Curren Chan began.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan demonstrates undeniable 
ability as a sprinter. However, by doing 
things like updating her social media 
during practice, she doesn't seem entirely 
serious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when checking in on future plans once 
more— The goal? "To spread the word about 
cute Curren!" The racing goal? "Hmm... 
none, I guess!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, she took an interest in the 
"Triple Tiara," a title difficult to 
achieve given her distance aptitudes. It 
seems she has ideas of her own, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Just what are Curren Chan's true 
intentions? Though already being led 
around by the nose, their days of chasing 
'cuteness' together have begun."
